id: 19_Replace the Rocker Switch for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 带把手机型电源开关的规范更换（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/19_Replace the Rocker Switch for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/19_Replace the Rocker Switch for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带把手的激光焊接机背面，指着后盖上的红色开关，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the back of a gray wheeled laser welding machine with handles, points at the red rocker switch on its rear cover, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，换另一款焊机的电源开关。
overlay: 带把手机型电源开关的规范更换

shots.scene: 四个图标：闪电恢复的灯泡、手摸机壳、点检表、墙上的告示板
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a light bulb with a returning lightning bolt, a hand touching a machine case, a checklist and a notice board on a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 换好开关，用电习惯也要跟上。

shots.scene: 实验室灯突然熄灭，阿杰的焊机也停了
shots.prompt_en: The lab lights suddenly go out and the young male student's laser welding machine stops.
shots.narration: 实验楼突然停电，焊机也停了。

shots.scene: 来电后焊机突然自己启动，风扇呼呼转，阿杰吓一跳
shots.prompt_en: When power returns, the machine suddenly starts by itself with its fan whirring, and the young male student jumps back in surprise.
shots.narration: 来电那一刻，焊机自己又启动了。

shots.scene: 小研关掉开关，开关一按就松垮，老李来看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches it off; the rocker switch feels loose and wobbly, and the facility engineer comes to check.
shots.narration: 开关也松了，老李决定换开关。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一根手指，旁边灯泡熄灭的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger next to an icon of a light bulb going dark.
shots.narration: 停电或跳闸，先把设备开关关掉。

shots.scene: 来电时机器突然启动、人在旁边吓到的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine suddenly starting when power returns while a person stands next to it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不然来电时机器突然动作，很危险。

shots.scene: 小研关掉开关，查明原因后再开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student keeps the switch off and checks a blank notice before switching on again.
shots.narration: 查明原因、确认安全，再重新开机。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 换开关要拆机，只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后仍有残余高压，按说明书等待。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 木板上摆着一把内六角扳手、一把一字螺丝刀、一把十字螺丝刀和一个红色船形开关
shots.prompt_en: On a wooden board lie a hex key, a flat-head screwdriver, a cross-head screwdriver and a new red rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 内六角、一字刀、十字刀和新开关。

shots.scene: 老李拔下机器背面所有线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs all cables from the back of the machine.
shots.narration: 拔掉设备上的所有线缆。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角松开后把手一侧的两颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loosens two screws on one side of the rear handle with a hex key.
shots.narration: 松开后把手一侧的两颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 拆最后一颗螺钉时，老李另一只手托住把手
shots.prompt_en: While removing the last screw, the facility engineer supports the handle with his other hand.
shots.narration: 拆最后一颗时扶住把手，别让它砸下。

shots.scene: 老李用十字刀拆下后盖的四颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the four screws of the rear cover with a cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 拆下后盖四颗螺钉，翻开后盖。

shots.scene: 后盖翻开，开关背面四根线的插片被逐个拔下
shots.prompt_en: The rear cover is tilted open and the four wire connectors on the back of the switch are pulled off one by one.
shots.narration: 拔下开关背面的四根线。

shots.scene: 画面一角红箭头指着开关侧面的小卡舌
shots.prompt_en: A small inset with red arrows points at the small locking tabs on the sides of the rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 开关四边各有一个锁定卡舌。

shots.scene: 一字刀轮流按压卡舌，另一只手从内侧推开关
shots.prompt_en: A flat-head screwdriver presses the tabs one after another while the other hand pushes the switch out from the inside.
shots.narration: 一字刀交替按卡舌，从里往外推。

shots.scene: 新开关从后盖外侧插入，圆圈一端朝下
shots.prompt_en: The new rocker switch is inserted into the rear cover from the outside, with its circle symbol end facing down.
shots.narration: 新开关从外侧插入，圆圈朝下。

shots.scene: 两台机器的开关都是按下端为关
shots.prompt_en: Two machines side by side, both switches with the circle end at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 方向统一，大家按开关才不会弄反。

shots.scene: 两根短线插到开关上方端子，两根长线插到下方端子
shots.prompt_en: Two shorter wires are pushed onto the top terminals of the switch and two longer wires onto the bottom terminals.
shots.narration: 短线接上方，长线接下方。

shots.scene: 老李轻拉每根插片线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently tugs each wire connector.
shots.narration: 插到底，轻拉不脱。

shots.scene: 后盖合上，四颗螺钉拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The rear cover is closed and its four screws are tightened.
shots.narration: 装回后盖，拧紧全部螺钉。

shots.scene: 后把手装回，内六角拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The rear handle is refitted and tightened with a hex key.
shots.narration: 装回后把手。

shots.scene: 阿杰手背碰到机壳，手上出现麻电的波纹图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's hand touches the machine case and a tingling wave icon appears on his hand.
shots.narration: 碰到机壳手发麻，说明可能漏电。

shots.scene: 小研立即拉下墙上开关，挂上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student immediately switches off the wall breaker and hangs a blank out-of-service tag.
shots.narration: 马上断电，挂牌停用，报修。

shots.scene: 再摸一次试试的手被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching to touch the case again to test, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要再去摸着试。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白点检卡站在焊机前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of the machine holding a blank pre-use checklist card.
shots.narration: 每次开机前，按点检卡看一遍。

shots.scene: 点检项目图标：开关、急停、线缆、外壳、气源
shots.prompt_en: Checklist icons in a row: a rocker switch, an emergency stop button, a cable, a machine case and a gas valve. No people.
shots.narration: 开关、急停、线缆、外壳、气源。

shots.scene: 阿杰在点检卡上打勾，有一项画问号便停下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ticks items on the card; at one item he draws a question mark and stops.
shots.narration: 有一项不对，就先不开机。

shots.scene: 焊机旁墙上贴着空白的操作规程和电话卡
shots.prompt_en: On the wall beside the machine hang a blank operating procedure sheet and a blank emergency contact card.
shots.narration: 设备旁贴好操作规程和应急电话。

shots.scene: 电话卡上只有电话图标、数字119和120
shots.prompt_en: A close view of the contact card showing a phone icon and the numbers 119 and 120. No people.
shots.narration: 火警119，急救120，再报告负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a dark light bulb, a tingling hand, a checklist and a wall notice.
shots.narration: 停电先关开关，发麻立即停用。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 开机前点检，规程电话贴在旁边。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手，墙上贴着告示
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye beside the machine, with notices on the wall.
shots.narration: 开关在手，安全在心。下次见！
